rules: Smog week: of every 7-day window from 2025-12 to 2026-02, the one with the highest mean of the hourly national means of PM2.5 at the automatic GIOŚ stations.
Each hex shows the inverse-distance-weighted mean of the stations within 40 km that measured that hour; hexes farther from every station stay empty.
